description.en: Kimi Code Swarm-style batch parallel subagent dispatch: a `swarm_batch` tool fans independent subtasks out to real subagents with two-stage adaptive concurrency (ramp-up plus rate-limit backoff with auto shrink/recover), an in-chat live progress stream (SSE), and `resume_agent_ids` resumable runs.
description.zh: Kimi Code Swarm 风格的批量并行子 Agent 调度：`swarm_batch` 工具把互不依赖的子任务批量派发给真实子 Agent，两阶段自适应并发（爬坡 + 撞限流指数退避并自动收缩/恢复），聊天内 SSE 实时进度流，并支持 `resume_agent_ids` 断点续做。
